# free-ai-agent-stack — complete catalogue

Maintained by Adarsh Kushwah (Dev Animecx). Canonical: https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack. Source: https://github.com/DevAnimecx/free-ai-agent-stack
Exported: 2026-09-24T13:21:14+00:00 · Entries: 384 · Licence: CC BY 4.0

Every entry below was verified by a human on the date shown. `requires_card`
defaults to true when unknown. An entry with status `deprecated` no longer
offers what it is listed for, and is kept so it is not re-recommended.

## Free LLM APIs (70 entries)

Category page: https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack/llm-apis/

### Google Gemini API — id `google-gemini`
Frontier multimodal models on a permanent free tier — Flash and Flash-Lite families only since April 2026.

- Provider: Google
- Free limit: 1,500 requests/day on Flash, 1,000/day on Flash-Lite; 250K TPM
- Rate limit: 10-15 RPM, 250K TPM
- Context window: 1000000
- Credit card required: no
- Tags: essential, multimodal, long-context, frontier, no-card
- Status: active
- Verified: 2026-09-24 by @seed-import
- URL: https://ai.google.dev
- Citation: https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack/llm-apis/#google-gemini

### Groq Cloud — id `groq`
Open-weight models at 300+ tokens/sec on LPU hardware, with the most generous request-per-day allowance of any free tier.

- Provider: Groq
- Free limit: 1,000 req/day and 200K tokens/day per model
- Rate limit: 30 RPM, 8K TPM
- Context window: 131072
- Credit card required: no
- Tags: essential, fast-inference, openai-compatible, no-card, agents
- Status: active
- Verified: 2026-09-24 by @seed-import
- URL: https://groq.com
- Citation: https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack/llm-apis/#groq

### OpenRouter Free Models — id `openrouter-free`
One OpenAI-compatible key fronting 19+ `:free` models across providers — the best way to A/B models without multiple signups.

- Provider: OpenRouter
- Free limit: 50 requests/day (1,000/day after a one-time $10 credit purchase)
- Rate limit: 20 RPM
- Context window: 262144
- Credit card required: no
- Tags: essential, multi-provider, openai-compatible, model-comparison, no-card
- Status: active
- Verified: 2026-09-24 by @seed-import
- URL: https://openrouter.ai
- Citation: https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack/llm-apis/#openrouter-free

### Cloudflare Workers AI — id `cloudflare-workers-ai`
Serverless inference that runs inside a Worker — no egress cost, no cold-start management, free daily budget.

- Provider: Cloudflare
- Free limit: 10,000 Neurons/day (roughly 3-8K short LLM calls/day)
- Rate limit: Account-level; unchanged by plan
- Credit card required: no
- Tags: essential, edge, serverless, embeddings, no-card
- Status: active
- Verified: 2026-09-24 by @seed-import
- URL: https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/
- Citation: https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack/llm-apis/#cloudflare-workers-ai

### GitHub Models — id `github-models`
Frontier and open models behind a GitHub PAT — the lowest-friction free tier if you already have a GitHub account.

- Provider: GitHub / Microsoft
- Free limit: 150-1,000 requests/day depending on tier and model
- Rate limit: 15 RPM
- Credit card required: no
- Tags: essential, frontier, no-card, github-native, prototyping
- Status: active
- Verified: 2026-09-24 by @seed-import
- URL: https://github.com/features/models
- Citation: https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack/llm-apis/#github-models

### Mistral La Plateforme (Experiment) — id `mistral-la-plateforme`
European-hosted Mistral family with a free Experiment mode worth roughly $10/month of credits, no card required.

- Provider: Mistral AI
- Free limit: ~$10/month of credits in Experiment mode (about 1B tokens/month on small models)
- Rate limit: 2 RPM on free mode
- Credit card required: no
- Tags: essential, eu-hosted, code, gdpr-friendly, no-card
- Status: active
- Verified: 2026-09-24 by @seed-import
- URL: https://mistral.ai
- Citation: https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack/llm-apis/#mistral-la-plateforme

### NVIDIA NIM API Catalog — id `nvidia-nim`
Free hosted endpoints for NVIDIA-curated open models (Nemotron, Llama, DeepSeek), built for prototyping.

- Provider: NVIDIA
- Free limit: 1,000 API credits (26,000 total requests) on signup
- Rate limit: Up to 40 RPM
- Credit card required: no
- Tags: essential, frontier, open-models, prototyping, no-card
- Status: active
- Verified: 2026-09-24 by @seed-import
- URL: https://build.nvidia.com
- Citation: https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack/llm-apis/#nvidia-nim

### Z.ai GLM Flash Models — id `zai-glm-free`
GLM-4.x Flash models served free of charge, popular as a drop-in for reasoning and coding agents.

- Provider: Z.ai (Zhipu)
- Free limit: Unmetered access to GLM-4.7-Flash and GLM-4.5-Flash
- Rate limit: Community-tier concurrency limits
- Context window: 128000
- Credit card required: no
- Tags: agentic, coding, no-card
- Status: active
- Verified: 2026-09-24 by @seed-import
- URL: https://z.ai
- Citation: https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack/llm-apis/#zai-glm-free

### Alibaba Cloud Model Studio — id `alibaba-model-studio`
Qwen family access with a free per-model token grant — the cleanest route to Qwen3 Coder for free.

- Provider: Alibaba Cloud
- Free limit: ~1M free tokens per model, valid 90 days
- Rate limit: Low RPM on free quota
- Context window: 1000000
- Credit card required: no
- Tags: qwen, long-context, coder, china
- Status: active
- Verified: 2026-09-24 by @seed-import
- URL: https://www.alibabacloud.com/en/product/modelstudio
- Citation: https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack/llm-apis/#alibaba-model-studio

Figma's own MCP server, hosted at mcp.figma.com over Streamable HTTP. Reads a selected frame's variables, components and layout into the editor, generates code from it, reuses real components through Code Connect and, while in beta, writes native content back to the canvas.

- Maintainer: Figma
- Install: claude mcp add --transport http figma https://mcp.figma.com/mcp
- Authentication: Figma account (OAuth)
- Stars: 2016
- Authentication required: yes
- Tags: design, official, remote, frontend
- Status: active
- Verified: 2026-09-24 by @hidden-gems-import
- URL: https://github.com/figma/mcp-server-guide
- Citation: https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack/mcp-servers/#figma-mcp-server
- Note: A hosted remote server rather than a package: https://mcp.figma.com/mcp answers 401 without a token, so there is nothing to install — you add the URL and authenticate.
- Note: Free to connect on Figma's free Starter plan, but that plan and View or Collab seats on paid plans are capped at 6 tool calls per month. Dev and Full seats on paid plans get Tier 1 REST API limits instead. This is a real free allowance, not a generous one — the Studio plan at $16/month is what most people will need for daily use.
- Note: Writing to the canvas is free during the beta, and Figma has said it will become a usage-based paid feature. Assume it will not stay free.
- Note: Also installable as Claude Code and Cursor plugins and as a Gemini CLI extension, which bundle the server config together with the Figma skill pack below.

### MemPalace — id `mempalace`
Local-first memory for agents that stores conversations verbatim in ChromaDB and organises them into wings, halls and rooms instead of letting an LLM decide what is worth keeping.

- Free limit: Free — MIT licensed, runs locally with zero API calls
- Install: pip install mempalace && mempalace init
- Licence: MIT
- Stars: 59259
- Open source: yes
- Credit card required: no
- Tags: memory, rag, local-first, mit, mcp, hidden-gem
- Status: active
- Verified: 2026-09-24 by @hidden-gems-import
- URL: https://github.com/milla-jovovich/mempalace
- Citation: https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack/agent-tools/#mempalace
- Note: Co-created by Milla Jovovich and Ben Sigman.
- Note: Often quoted as "100% on benchmarks" — that is the hybrid pipeline with cloud reranking, which the authors themselves flagged as tuned on failing questions. The defensible numbers are 96.6% R@5 raw on LongMemEval with zero API calls and a 98.4% held-out hybrid score.
- Note: The project publicly walked back an overstated "30x lossless compression" claim; its experimental AAAK mode actually regresses to 84.2%.

### Oracle Cloud Always Free — id `oracle-cloud-always-free`
The only genuinely free-forever VPS with usable specs — 2 Arm Ampere cores and 12GB RAM running 24/7, as one VM or split in two.

- Free limit: 2 ARM OCPUs + 12GB RAM, 200GB storage, 10TB egress/mo, forever
- Credit card required: yes
- Tags: arm, capacity-scarce, vm, always-free, self-host, essential
- Status: active
- Verified: 2026-09-24 by @seed-import
- URL: https://www.oracle.com/cloud/free/
- Citation: https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack/free-tiers/#oracle-cloud-always-free
- Note: Oracle halved this allowance on 15 June 2026 — 4 OCPU/24GB became 2 OCPU/12GB — with no announcement, only a quiet docs edit.
- Note: Instances above the new limit were terminated after 18 August 2026.
- Note: The pool is tenancy-wide, not per-instance.
- Note: Idle instances are reclaimed: under 20% 95th-percentile CPU, network and memory across a seven-day window.
- Note: Signup rejections are routine, and ARM capacity is scarce enough that launches frequently fail with "Out of capacity"; Pay As You Go accounts reportedly keep the old 4/24 allowance for free.

e2-micro VM, Cloud Run and Firestore allowances, plus the $300 new-account credit.

### Hugging Face Spaces — id `huggingface-spaces`
Free Docker or Gradio container hosting with a permanent public URL — 2 vCPU and 16GB RAM on the CPU Basic tier, enough for a real service rather than a toy demo.

- Free limit: 2 vCPU / 16GB RAM / 50GB ephemeral disk, unlimited Spaces
- Credit card required: no
- Tags: demos, gradio, docker, ml, no-card, free-forever
- Status: active
- Verified: 2026-09-24 by @hidden-gems-import
- URL: https://huggingface.co/spaces
- Citation: https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack/free-tiers/#huggingface-spaces
- Note: One of the most generous free CPU containers available, and it needs no card at any point.
- Note: Spaces sleep after inactivity and cold-start on the next visit, so this is not an always-on host without a keep-alive.
- Note: The 50GB disk is ephemeral and resets on every restart; persistent /data storage is a paid upgrade from $5/mo for 20GB. Back state up to a Storage Bucket or dataset repo instead.
- Note: Private Spaces are restricted on the free tier, so treat a free Space as public.

### Google AI Studio Starter Tier — id `google-ai-studio-starter`
No-card deployment path from AI Studio: prompt an app, click Publish, and get a live Cloud Run URL backed by Firestore or Cloud SQL plus Firebase Auth.

- Free limit: Two full-stack apps, no time limit, no billing account
- Credit card required: no
- Tags: paas, no-card, cloud-run, firebase, postgres, hidden-gem
- Status: active
- Verified: 2026-09-24 by @hidden-gems-import
- URL: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/billing
- Citation: https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack/free-tiers/#google-ai-studio-starter
- Note: The single best no-card full-stack path in this catalogue — a Google Account is genuinely enough, with no billing account created.
- Note: Hard limits: two active apps, 1GiB stored data, 10GiB egress/month, 40K writes and 50K reads a day, one locked-in region, and no BigQuery or Pub/Sub.
- Note: You are ineligible if you have ever held a Google Cloud billing account.
- Note: Cloud Run scales to zero, so expect a cold start on the first request.

### Hugging Face ZeroGPU — id `huggingface-zerogpu`
Shared on-demand GPU for Spaces, allocated per request rather than held for the lifetime of the Space — so a demo can use real GPU acceleration without paying hourly.

- Free limit: Free daily quota of GPU time, per-user
- Credit card required: no
- Tags: gpu, serverless, shared, quota, hidden-gem
- Status: active
- Verified: 2026-09-24 by @hidden-gems-import
- URL: https://huggingface.co/docs/hub/spaces-zerogpu
- Citation: https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack/free-tiers/#huggingface-zerogpu
- Note: The quota is measured in minutes of GPU time per day and is small (sources report roughly 3.5 minutes authenticated against 2 unauthenticated), so this is for demos and short inference, not training or long-running agents.
- Note: Submission claimed the hardware is an RTX Pro 6000 Blackwell; other sources report H200.
- Note: Treat the exact GPU as variable — Hugging Face rotates the pool, and the quota is the part that actually constrains you.

### Zeabur — id `zeabur`
Deploy from a repository or a Dockerfile with services and databases wired together, on a free plan that needs no credit card.

- Free limit: Free plan — sign up and deploy, no card
- Credit card required: no
- Tags: paas, docker, no-card, hidden-gem
- Status: active
- Verified: 2026-09-24 by @hidden-gems-import
- URL: https://zeabur.com/docs/en-US/pricing/free-plan
- Citation: https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack/free-tiers/#zeabur
- Note: Two claims in the submission were wrong in opposite directions, both worth knowing.
- Note: Zeabur's free plan requires NO credit card (the submission said it did), and it DOES auto-sleep after inactivity (the submission said it did not) — the wake-up request pays a cold-start penalty.
- Note: There is also no SLA on the free plan and no automated database backup, which matters if you treat it as production.
- Note: The $5/mo figure quoted as a free credit is actually the price of the paid Dev plan.

### AMD Developer Cloud — id `amd-developer-cloud`
Access to AMD Instinct MI300X GPUs with 192GB of HBM3 — enough to run 70B+ parameter models on a single instance without model parallelism — for ROCm and vLLM work.

- Free limit: $100 in credits for AMD AI Developer Program members
- Credit card required: yes
- Tags: gpu, mi300x, rocm, trial, vllm, hidden-gem
- Status: active
- Verified: 2026-09-24 by @hidden-gems-import
- URL: https://devcloud.amd.com/
- Citation: https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack/free-tiers/#amd-developer-cloud
- Note: Listed as a `trial`, not a free tier.
- Note: The submission described this as simply "free" with no card; in fact a valid credit card is required at account creation, the $100 is a one-off credit rather than a rechargeable tier, and the credit hours expire (AMD's own pages disagree — 30 days on the current page, 10 days in older guidance).
- Note: Credits apply only to MI300X instances, and you are billed for powered-off instances until you destroy them.
- Note: Qualifies under OQ-3 (>= $100 and >= 30 days) and is excluded from every no-card filter.

India-hosted serverless GPU platform with NVIDIA H100 and L40S instances billed per minute and scaling to zero, plus OpenAI-compatible AI endpoints and LoRA fine-tuning.

- Free limit: ₹10,000 in credits on signup (about $115)

- Tags: gpu, h100, india, serverless, trial, hidden-gem

## Agent Skills (78 entries)

Category page: https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack/skills/

### Anthropic Agent Skills — id `anthropics-skills`
Anthropic's official skills repository — first-party packs that teach Claude Code and other agents house workflows: document handling, spreadsheet and slide authoring, PDF work and more.

- Provider: Anthropic
- Install: npx skills add anthropics/skills
- Licence: See repository (per-skill licences)
- Skills: 19
- Stars: 177887
- Open source: yes
- Tags: official, catalog, documents, essential, skills
- Status: active
- Verified: 2026-09-24 by @hidden-gems-import
- URL: https://github.com/anthropics/skills
- Citation: https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack/skills/#anthropics-skills
- Note: The repository tree holds 19 skills plus a template directory; the largest skills project by a wide margin and the reference implementation of the format.
- Note: `npx skills add anthropics/skills` was verified by running it — the skills CLI lists and installs this pack like any other source.
- Note: Individual skills carry their own licences, so check the subfolder rather than assuming the repository licence covers everything.

### OpenAI Skills Catalog — id `openai-skills`
OpenAI's curated Codex skills catalog — 39 maintained skills covering PDFs, GitHub CI repair, Playwright automation, deployment to Vercel, Cloudflare, Netlify and Render, Notion, Linear, Figma and security review. Superseded by openai/plugins, but still installable.

- Provider: OpenAI
- Install: npx skills add openai/skills
- Skills: 39
- Stars: 27599
- Open source: yes
- Tags: official, catalog, devops, security, skills
- Status: deprecated
- Verified: 2026-09-24 by @hidden-gems-import
- URL: https://github.com/openai/skills
- Citation: https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack/skills/#openai-skills
- Note: Deprecated by OpenAI: the repository README now directs new work to openai/plugins. The 39 curated skills still install and the repository is not archived — it was last pushed 2026-09-08.
- Note: All 39 entries under skills/.curated/ were checked one by one on 2026-09-24 and every SKILL.md resolves, including figma-use, migrate-to-codex, hatch-pet, winui-app and playwright-interactive.
- Note: skills/.system/ holds five further skills that ship with Codex and install automatically: imagegen, openai-docs, plugin-creator, skill-creator and skill-installer.
- Note: Skills widely listed online as OpenAI's — a .docx editor, a spreadsheet skill, Sora video and a web-game skill — exist at no path in this catalogue. Image generation does exist, but as the imagegen system skill above rather than a curated one.

### Superpowers — id `superpowers`
An agentic skills framework and software-development methodology — a structured approach to planning, implementing and reviewing work with an agent, published as installable skills.

- Provider: obra (Jesse Vincent)
- Install: npx skills add obra/superpowers
- Skills: 15
- Stars: 290953
- Open source: yes
- Tags: methodology, workflow, community, skills
- Status: active
- Verified: 2026-09-24 by @hidden-gems-import
- URL: https://github.com/obra/superpowers
- Citation: https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack/skills/#superpowers
- Note: 15 skills read from the repository tree, and `npx skills add obra/superpowers` was verified by running it.
- Note: OpenAI ships this methodology as a plugin of its own inside openai/plugins — an unusual case of a community project being blessed upstream. One of the most-starred repositories on GitHub; treat the stars as the reason to look, not the reason to trust.

### ClawHub — id `clawhub`
The skills and plugins registry for OpenClaw — 942 skills from verified publishers in the feed ClawHub publishes, sitting in front of a much larger open catalogue of community uploads.

- Provider: OpenClaw
- Skills: 942
- Tags: registry, marketplace, openclaw, skills
- Status: active
- Verified: 2026-09-24 by @hidden-gems-import
- URL: https://clawhub.ai/
- Citation: https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack/skills/#clawhub
- Note: The 942 counted here are the entries in ClawHub's own feed at /v1/feeds/skills (edition of 2026-09-24), which covers skills from verified publishers. It is the figure the registry publishes.
- Note: The open catalogue behind that feed is far larger and is not counted here: walking the site's listing API passed 12,892 unique slugs without finishing, and that endpoint is disallowed by the site's own robots.txt — so the open catalogue has no permitted, enumerable source and gets no number.
- Note: Skills install with `openclaw skills install @owner/slug`, verified against OpenClaw's documentation.
- Note: A skill URL cannot be checked with a status code: every /skills/<slug> page answers HTTP 200, invented slugs included. Checking one by hand works through the API instead — /api/v1/skills/<slug> returns 404 when a slug does not exist, 409 AMBIGUOUS_SKILL_SLUG when several owners share it, which is why @owner/slug is the only unambiguous reference.
- Note: Size and usage are different numbers: the top packages sit in the 100k–480k download range and most listings show none at all.
- Note: Includes a large Chinese-language catalogue alongside English packages.

### skills.sh — id `skills-sh`
A web directory for agent skills with a CLI installer, built to make discovering and adding a skill a single command.

- Provider: Vercel Labs
- Install: npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills
- Tags: registry, directory, vercel, skills
- Status: active
- Verified: 2026-09-24 by @hidden-gems-import
- URL: https://skills.sh/
- Citation: https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack/skills/#skills-sh
- Note: Moved from degraded to active: the registry has a public search API at skills.sh/api/search?q= that returns skill ids with install counts, which is how every skills.sh entry in this file was verified. The site's own pages still return HTTP 200 for any path, so only the API can confirm a skill exists.
- Note: /api/v1/skills requires a Vercel OIDC token, so the search endpoint is the usable one.
- Note: The CLI that powers it is open source (vercel-labs/skills, 32,380 stars) and `npx skills add <source> --skill <name>` was verified by running it against seven sources, including packs outside Vercel's own.
- Note: Install counts are lopsided: vercel-labs/skills/find-skills showed 3,539,754 installs against roughly 7,000 for CrewAI's four skills and a few hundred for smaller packs.

### SkillsMP — id `skillsmp`
An agent-skills marketplace indexing Codex and Claude skills, with browsing by creator and occupation.

- Provider: SkillsMP
- Tags: registry, marketplace, skills
- Status: active
- Verified: 2026-09-24 by @hidden-gems-import
- URL: https://skillsmp.com/
- Citation: https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack/skills/#skillsmp
- Note: Moved from degraded to active: its current URL scheme returns honest 404s. /creators/<owner>/<repo>/<skill> resolves for real skills and 404s for invented ones, in both cases tested.
- Note: The older /skills/<slug> URLs that circulate in aggregator posts are dead — they return a page titled 'Legacy skill URL not found'.
- Note: The site advertises 200,000+ skills. That is its own claim: there is no public API and the catalogue is not enumerable in a way we could count, so no skill_count is stated here.
- Note: Much of what it indexes mirrors public GitHub repositories, so the canonical copy usually lives on GitHub rather than here.

### OpenAI Plugins — id `openai-plugins`
OpenAI's current home for Codex skills and plugins — 62 plugin packages holding 536 skills, from first-party tooling to integrations published by Adobe, Atlassian, Canva, Cloudflare, Datadog, Figma, GitHub, Linear, Notion, Sentry, Stripe, Supabase, Vercel and more.

- Provider: OpenAI
- Skills: 536
- Stars: 7141
- Tags: official, catalog, plugins, skills
- Status: active
- Verified: 2026-09-24 by @hidden-gems-import
- URL: https://github.com/openai/plugins
- Citation: https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack/skills/#openai-plugins
- Note: Successor to openai/skills. Read from the repository tree on 2026-09-24: 62 directories under plugins/, containing 536 SKILL.md files.
- Note: Heaviest packages: twilio-developer-kit (55 skills), vercel (54), zoom (53), life-science-research (50), public-equity-investing (23), shopify (20), build-web-data-visualization (18), data-analytics (18), ngs-analysis (18).
- Note: Layout is one directory per plugin with skills, commands, agents, hooks.json and an .mcp.json, not a flat skills/ tree — the generic skills CLI does not traverse it, so these install through Codex.
- Note: No repository-level licence; each plugin carries its own LICENSE.txt.

### Vercel Agent Skills — id `vercel-agent-skills`
Vercel's official skills for React and Next.js work and for shipping to Vercel: React best practices, composition patterns, view transitions, React Native, deployment, optimising cost and performance, plus web design and writing guidelines.

- Note: The same lab builds the skills.sh registry and its CLI, so these are the reference example of a vendor pack that installs cleanly through `npx skills add`.

### Browserbase Skills — id `browserbase-skills`
Browserbase's official skills for reaching the web from an agent — search without a browser session, fetch a URL, drive a full browser, convert a browser flow into an API call, trace sessions, run adversarial UI tests and research a company.

- Provider: Browserbase
- Install: npx skills add browserbase/skills
- Skills: 18
- Stars: 3731
- Tags: vendor, browser, automation, skills
- Status: active
- Verified: 2026-09-24 by @hidden-gems-import
- URL: https://github.com/browserbase/skills
- Citation: https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack/skills/#browserbase-skills
- Note: Eighteen skills read from the repository tree. The pack distinguishes cheap paths (search, fetch) from expensive ones (full browser sessions), which is the cost decision agents usually get wrong.

### browse.sh — id `browse-sh`
An open catalogue of browser-automation skills keyed by site: each entry names a domain, a skill and the method that reaches it, so an agent can ask what is already known about a site before writing a scraper from scratch.

- Provider: Browserbase
- Install: npm i -g browse
- Tags: registry, browser, automation, skills
- Status: active
- Verified: 2026-09-24 by @hidden-gems-import
- URL: https://browse.sh/
- Citation: https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack/skills/#browse-sh
- Note: Published by the Browserbase team; the CLI is the npm package `browse` ("Unified Browserbase CLI for browser automation and cloud APIs"), which we confirmed exists under Browserbase maintainers.
- Note: No count is claimed here: the catalogue is not exposed by a public API and the page does not state a size, so unlike the other registries in this file there is nothing to verify against.
- Note: Entries read like `sam.gov · contract-opportunity-search · api` — a domain, the job and how to reach it.

### Exa Contents — id `exa-contents`
Calls the Exa Contents endpoint with cURL or raw HTTP when an agent already has URLs and needs page text, highlights, summaries, links, subpages or per-URL status without an SDK.

- Note: One of five skills in the Exa pack. 673 installs in the skills.sh registry. Exa has a free allowance, so both the skill and the API it drives are usable at no cost.

### Figma Agent Skills — id `figma-skills`
Figma's own skill pack for working with design files through its MCP server — implementing designs as code, connecting components with Code Connect, generating design libraries and diagrams, and building Figma slides, FigJam boards, shaders and motion.

- Provider: Figma
- Install: claude plugin install figma@claude-plugins-official
- Skills: 30
- Stars: 2016
- Tags: vendor, design, figma, skills
- Status: active
- Verified: 2026-09-24 by @hidden-gems-import
- URL: https://github.com/figma/mcp-server-guide/tree/main/skills
- Citation: https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack/skills/#figma-skills
- Note: 30 skills counted from the repository tree on 2026-09-24: 14 under skills/, the same 14 mirrored under skills-figquery/ for the Figma query variant, and 2 workflow skills. Distribute through Figma's plugins rather than a bare skills/ directory.
- Note: Figma marks these a Beta feature, and the pack ships with no repository licence file — check the developer terms before depending on it.
- Note: The pack is what the OpenAI curated figma-* skills wrap: same job, published by the vendor whose API it drives.

### Alireza Rezvani Claude Skills — id `alirezarezvani-claude-skills`
A large community skill library spanning engineering, marketing, product, compliance, finance and C-level advisory work — 388 skills plus custom agents, commands and references, installable across a dozen coding agents.

- Provider: alirezarezvani
- Install: npx skills add alirezarezvani/claude-skills
- Licence: MIT
- Skills: 388
- Stars: 26387
- Open source: yes
- Tags: community, library, engineering, skills
- Status: active
- Verified: 2026-09-24 by @hidden-gems-import
- URL: https://github.com/alirezarezvani/claude-skills
- Citation: https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack/skills/#alirezarezvani-claude-skills
- Note: 388 skills, being the 846 SKILL.md files in the repository tree minus 458 that are mirrors under .gemini/ — 369 skill names appear twice for that reason. The README says '380+' and the skills CLI lists 367, so the true figure sits in that range; 388 is the number the tree supports once mirrors are excluded.
- Note: MIT licensed, 26,387 stars, and actively maintained — the largest community pack here after obra/superpowers.
- Note: Breadth is the point and also the risk: 388 skills in one repository means most of them are not for you, and a pack this size is a lot of third-party instruction to hand an agent. Install individual skills (--skill <name>) rather than the whole library.

### A11y Audit — id `a11y-audit`
An accessibility audit pipeline over WCAG 2.2 Level A and AA: scan, fix and verify, with per-framework fix code and a compliance report. Covers React, Next.js, Vue, Angular, Svelte and plain HTML, and can run the checks in CI.

- Install: npx skills add alirezarezvani/claude-skills --skill a11y-audit

- Status: active

- Citation: https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack/skills/#a11y-audit
- Note: 934 installs in the skills.sh registry, where it is the second-most-installed result for its name.
- Note: Listed on ClawHub in the source dossier but absent there under that slug. This is the real one — verified in the skills.sh registry and in the repository tree, where the skill lives at engineering-team/a11y-audit/skills/a11y-audit alongside a mirrored copy.

### Notion API — id `notion-api`
Drives a Notion workspace through the REST API with curl and jq rather than a vendor SDK or connector: query a database, create and update pages, and walk blocks, from any agent that can run shell commands.

- Provider: Intellectronica
- Install: npx skills add intellectronica/agent-skills --skill notion-api
- Tags: skill, community, notion, database
- Status: active
- Verified: 2026-09-24 by @hidden-gems-import
- URL: https://github.com/intellectronica/agent-skills/tree/main/skills/notion-api
- Citation: https://devanimecx.github.io/free-ai-agent-stack/skills/#notion-api
- Note: 78,501 installs in the skills.sh registry — the second-highest of any skill measured for this catalogue, behind only Vercel's find-skills at 3,539,754.
- Note: The pack publishes this skill twice, at skills/notion-api/ and plugins/notion-api/skills/, so the CLI's copy and the tree's copy are not the same path.
